ai.title: Enforce mandatory newlines in search/replace block parsing
ai.summary: The regex in `backend/src/generate-diffs-prompt.ts` now requires explicit newlines before `=======` and `>>>>>>> REPLACE` markers, removing optional newline matching. This ensures strict format compliance for AI-generated diffs and prevents parsing failures caused by malformed blocks.

eli5.text: When the assistant writes a suggested fix to your code, it now needs to put each section on its own clean line. Before, the system could misread a fix if two pieces of text were smushed together without a proper line break. This only affects how internally generated diff suggestions are parsed, so it doesn't change anything you see directly, but it prevents errors that could have caused some suggested edits to fail to apply.

ai.title: Make tab completion case-insensitive
ai.summary: Tab completion in npm-app/src/cli.ts now matches tokens case-insensitively. The filter and common-prefix logic lowercases both the input and candidate tokens before comparing. Affects the CLI's token and path matching.

eli5.text: When you press the Tab key in the command-line tool, it suggests names that match what you typed. If you started typing with any mix of uppercase and lowercase letters, it only found matches that used the exact same capitalization. Now it finds matches regardless of whether the letters you typed and the suggested names use uppercase or lowercase. The list of suggestions you see as you type is what changed, not how the tool works after you pick one.
